name: 薩菲爾女性偏武 · 雙手重刃
prompt: Production 2D hand-painted fantasy RPG animation sprite atlas. SQUARE RGB OPAQUE PURE MAGENTA #FF00FF background, no alpha. EXACT 6 columns by 6 rows, thirty-six SEPARATE full-body miniature sprites. Same person, costume, weapon, scale and right-facing three-quarter view every frame. Each sprite no more than 65% cell width, generous 35px magenta gutters, NO touching neighbouring poses. No text, no grid lines, no scenery or floor. Adult anatomy, fine painterly details at 150px character height, NOT chibi, NOT 3D. SUBJECT: athletic adult brown-skinned desert woman with long dark braid, narrow ivory headband, turquoise jacket and brass lamellar shoulder armor, crimson sash, loose ivory trousers and leather riding boots. Held equipment MUST be: a broad two-handed greatsword with long grip, both hands grasping it. SIX ROWS, each six frames: ROW1 idle breathing loop; ROW2 attack: ready, anticipation, windup, strong contact/release, follow-through, recovery. Both hands lift heavy sword over shoulder, strong overhead diagonal chop and weighty follow-through. ROW3 hit recoil and recovery; ROW4 defensive guard and recovery using this actual equipment, no extra sword; ROW5 evasive crouch step then recovery; ROW6 collapse/defeat ending lying motionless. SAME costume throughout: athletic adult brown-skinned desert woman with long dark braid, narrow ivory headband, turquoise jacket and brass lamellar shoulder armor, crimson sash, loose ivory trousers and leather riding boots. Weapon must remain recognizable, same proportions, grip anatomically correct. No swords except those explicitly requested. No touching neighbours. Solid opaque magenta everywhere between characters, no transparency.
